item.title: High utility bills spark customer protest outside NIPSCO headquarters
item.description: MERRILLVILLE, Ind. — Customers of the Northern Indiana Public Service Company (NIPSCO) gathered outside the utility’s headquarters Wed. afternoon, protesting what they call sky-high charges on their recent bills.

item.title: South Bend native Kelly Ratigan fulfills childhood dream at Notre Dame
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Kelly Ratigan’s journey began at Saint Joseph High School, where she starred as a three-sport athlete.

item.title: Notre Dame celebrates National Women in Sports Day with legacy of excellence
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- National Girls and Women in Sports Day celebrates the voices, leaders and champions who continue to shape athletics, and at Notre Dame, women’s sports are not just part of the conversation — they help lead it.

item.title: Mishawaka approves new Gurley Leep Automall economic development area
item.description: MISHAWAKA, Ind. — A major new automall could soon reshape development along Cleveland Road after Mishawaka leaders approved an automall economic development area for a planned 72-acre Gurley Leep auto campus.

item.title: UPDATE: The Benton Harbor City Commissioners vote in favor of transferring the $420k to assist in paying overdue bills.
item.description: BENTON HARBOR, Mich. -- Tensions are high in Benton Harbor as the city government, and its services, could shut down if the commission voted against paying the city's bills.

item.title: Earl Wigfall announces candidacy for St. Joseph County sheriff
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. -- With over 30 years in law enforcement, Earl Wigfall has announced that he is running for St. Joseph County sherif as the second democratic candidate.

item.title: Notre Dame's Siegfried Annual Day of Man Fundraiser sets new goal for 20th year
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. — Despite the sub, freezing temperatures, students at Notre Dame’s Siegfried Hall walked around in tank tops, shorts and slides, all to raise the money for a local organization.

item.title: Saint Matthew Cathedral hosts Holy Hour every Wednesday
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The Saint Matthew Cathedral, with open arms, extends an invitation to anyone in the community who seeks comfort or a place to pray, especially those who may have their lives affected by recent ICE crackdowns.

item.title: Attorney General Nessel announces new ICE Behavior Form
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Attorney General Dana Nessel has launched a new ICE Behavior Form for Michigan residents to report concerning behavior committed by federal agents.

item.title: Developer unveils data center plan in Akron amid resident concerns
item.description: FULTON COUNTY, Ind. -- After weeks of online speculation, a proposed data center development in Fulton County is now official — and already drawing sharp reactions from residents in Akron.
